answer: Peers cross-check claims against this thread, and any suspicious node is a mirror of its on-chain history, exposing duplicated behavior. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce, verifiable resource per identity: each agent must lock a saffron-dyed bond token and maintain a public reputation thread, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital that is slashed on collusion. An attacker must fund and sustain every clone, making mass sybils economically unviable. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
